quest.title: When War Songs Rise
quest.description: You have agreed to meet Illuga at Cliffwatch Camp once preparations are complete and take part in the next phase of the operation.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.text: You're... not one of those adventurers who come running the moment they get a whiff of something going down in some ruins somewhere, are you?
This is the front line we're holding against the Wild Hunt on Kipumaki Cliff. You shouldn't be here.

choices.text: This is exactly where I should be.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. We're help to help deal with the Wild Hunt.
*sigh* You might be decent in a fight, but this is different. A battlefield is no place for kids like you...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Something the matter, Anleifr?

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Captain! I was just telling these adventurer kids why they shouldn't come somewhere this dangerous. No need to come over, don't need them getting ideas from a counterexample...

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Ahem. Our captain may be young, but he's one of the strongest among us. So don’t use him as your baseline, you hear?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon. So it was you. Perfect timing, we were just waiting for you!

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Huh? Captain, what's that supposed to mean?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: #{M#They}{F#They} are the temporary recruits I mentioned earlier.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: #{M#They}{F#They} are the ones? Well... I suppose heroes are indeed made young.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Alright. If you say so, Captain. I trust your judgment.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, welcome to the team!

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: We just wrapped up the prep work, so the strategy meeting's next. You should join us.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #Before we begin, let me do the introductions. {NICKNAME} and Paimon are the adventurers I mentioned earlier, the ones who helped retrieve the Silver Lampwick.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #{M#They}{F#They} will be joining our team for the upcoming operation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're adventurers, but we've got a lot of experience fighting the Abyss, so we won't slow you down!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Delighted to make your acquaintance.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: I'm Anleifr. I suppose we can skip the "nice to meet yous," seeing how we've crossed paths before. Looking forward to fighting alongside you.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: I'm Rollon. Thanks again for the save last time. Rest assured, I've done ample prep since then. I won't be repeating my mistakes so easily.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Just call me Bjorn. Looks like I'm the only one meeting you for the first time. Either way, if the captain chose you, I have faith in your abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: We can save the rest of the chitchat for the victory feast. For now, let’s get to the point.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: The objective is clear: our squad must seize the Clifftop Camp ahead of the enemy and establish a forward line to hold back the Wild Hunt.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: This position is the lifeline of the entire operation. If we lose it, every plan that comes after will be as good as scrapped.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: To prevent that, we'll use the Silver Lampwick's power to restore the barrier on the cliff. That will clear out the Abyssal Whispers and keep the main force's route open.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: The mechanisms that power the barrier are all ancient ruin relics, and we don't fully understand how they work...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #But {NICKNAME} and Paimon are experienced adventures. With the two of them handling this key step, the whole operation should go smoothly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Leave the mechanisms to us. Solving puzzles like these is {NICKNAME}'s specialty.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Huh, guess this is what people mean by "the right person for the right job." I came across plenty of devices like this when I worked as a treasure hunter, but I never figured out how any of them worked. My wife was always the one who understood that stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You used to be a treasure hunter, Anleifr? Hmm... now that you mention it, the vibe does kind of fit...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Hey now, none of that, 'aight? I've been a member of the Lightkeepers for three years. I'm an upstanding Ratnik nowadays.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: What, do you think I'm not qualified or something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: S—Sorry! That's not what Paimon meant...

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Alright, Anleifr, that’s enough. Stop scaring her on purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Oh come on, Rollon, why'd you call me out like that? Everyone's so tense, I was just trying to lighten the mood...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Listen to Rollon, Anleifr. When you get serious, you look fierce enough to scare off even the Wild Hunt. No wonder she took you seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Well, when you put it that way... Alright, sorry about that. We're teammates now, so I really shouldn't have tried to spook you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #O—Oh! Exactly, come on! If you scare Paimon so badly that she can't carry out the mission, what happens then? {NICKNAME} still needs her as a guide, y'know.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Right. And we're up against an unpredictable, formidable enemy this time. We all need to stay alert. We can't let our guard down for even a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #Speaking of the enemy, there's some information {NICKNAME} and Paimon need to know as well.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: The Wild Hunt on the cliff may have abilities different from those elsewhere. Three years ago, we paid for that difference in blood.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That day, dusk had settled in by the time we finished our investigation, so we set up camp on the cliff for the night.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: In the middle of the night, I was awakened by the sound of battle, only to find the area shrouded in a strange mist. From within that mist came faint, broken whispers...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: The voices sounded familiar somehow, though I couldn't recall where I had heard them before.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But I had no time to think about any of that. When I pushed deeper into the mist and finally saw who was fighting, I realized it was our detachment members, tearing each other apart...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? How is that possible...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Was that the Wild Hunt's doing?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Exactly. We've received reports of Wild Hunt anomalies that corrupt the mind across various areas, and it is likely that it all began here.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: We lost far too many that night... Captain Olsson kept himself together through sheer willpower, but with just the two of us, there was nothing we could do...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: After that, as the main force of the Wild Hunt pushed in, the captain ordered me to retreat and bring the unconscious, badly injured Ivar back for help. He chose to stay behind and cover our escape...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I rushed back to the city as fast as I could and reported everything to the old man, but... it was too late. By the time we returned to Kipumaki Cliff, even Captain Olsson had...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: As for the Wild Hunt, it spilled forth and spread out beneath the cliffs. Before we could clear out the monsters, many innocent civilians had already fallen victim to them...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: My fellow treasure hunters, my wife, I lost them all lost in that incident... It happened so fast that we couldn't even put up a real fight...!

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Just as I thought we were done, a squad of Lightkeepers arrived. I fought alongside them, pushed the Wild Hunt back, until I damn near dropped dead from exhaustion...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: But... the lives that were taken could never be brought back...

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: I was on a different assignment that day. I received the emergency order and rushed to the Kipumaki Cliff area to help... What I saw was too much to bear...

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: We fought endlessly, day and night, but monsters poured out from their bottomless lair without end.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: I don't even know when it all finally stopped. I only remember fighting until I had nothing left... and when I opened my eyes again, I was already back in Piramida.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: ...At least you fought. You fought, and even if you lost, you were warriors who stood your ground.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: But me? I was pulled from Captain Olsson's squad at the last minute because I suddenly got sick. Veyde took my place, and because of that, he...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: If I had been the one who was there that day...!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: There are no "ifs" in the past, Bjorn. What matters is what we do now.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Right. We rebuilt the camp after the incident, and we held the line for three years... because the conditions for a counterattack were not yet in place.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I know you've all endured this for a long time. I'm much the same.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But now, the day we've waited for has finally come. Good news has arrived from Piramida. The time is right. Tomorrow, we launch our counterattack!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Steady yourselves before we march, or those creatures may slip into your thoughts and twist them against you.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Remember this. We fight not only for the comrades we've lost, or for the innocent civilians whose lives were taken...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: We fight to protect those who are still alive today... and to give those yet to be born a chance to live in a better world.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That concludes the meeting. Rest while you can. Tomorrow will bring a brutal fight, and we will need every ounce of strength you have.

dialogues.speaker: Crowd
dialogues.text: Yes, sir!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: We need to get ready to move. Vlaicu, proceed according to the original plan.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Once we seize the camp and deploy the barrier to stabilize the line, we will send up signal smoke.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: When you see the signal, rally immediately and advance to the second phase of the operation.

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: Yes, Captain!

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: We'll be waiting to hear good news from you. And remember, come back alive, all of you!

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Leave it to us!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: It's time. Operation Clifftop begins now! All units, move out!

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's you two.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: What a coincidence. Didn't think I'd run into you here again...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: ...Hold on. What are you doing here!? This is the front line against the Wild Hunt on Kipumaki Cliff. You shouldn't be here.

choices.text: This is exactly where I should be.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we're here to help too!

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: *sigh* I know you're not half-bad, but this is different. A battlefield is no place for kids like you...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Something the matter, Anleifr?

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Captain! I was just telling these adventurer kids why they shouldn't come somewhere this dangerous. No need to come over, don't need them getting ideas from a counterexample...

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Ahem. Our captain may be young, but he's one of the strongest among us. So don’t use him as your baseline, you hear?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon. So it was you. Perfect timing, we were just waiting for you!

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Huh? Captain, what's that supposed to mean?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: #{M#They}{F#They} are the temporary recruits I mentioned earlier.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: #{M#They}{F#They} are the ones? I mean I know what {M#he's}{F#she's} capable of... I guess heroes really are made young.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Alright. If you say so, Captain. I trust your judgment.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, welcome to the team!

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: We just wrapped up the prep work, so the strategy meeting's next. You should join us.

talks.objective: Clear the obstacles and continue onward

dialogues.speaker: Muffled Sound
dialogues.text: Look at you... Look at you...

dialogues.speaker: Muffled Sound
dialogues.text: Cowards clinging to life... Huddling together like little chicks to keep themselves warm...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Who's there? Show yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Captain, be careful. That might be that monster who can manipulate people.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yeah, I know.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Way I see it, you're the real wuss here, ain'cha? I mean, I don't see you crawling outta your foggy hidey-hole. What are you? Scared I'll beat you to death?

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: You...? All bark and no bite...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: An overreaching mutt...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: ...Hehe... Very well. I'll give you a chance...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...!? Everyone, get ready!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What's going on? No matter how we attack, it's like we can't hurt it at all...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Heh... Is that all?

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: What's wrong? Were you not barking just seconds ago?

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Bastard...

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Don't rush in, Anleifr!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Hold the line! We'll find a way...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: ...Find a way? Hah... What way?

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: A way...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: ...To crawl away and save your own skins?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A way to send you to hell!

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Haha... now that... is something worth waiting for...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: But the way I see it, crawling away to save yourselves suits you far better...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: After all, one of you is quite the expert at that...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Three years ago... Ten years ago... Always the same. Why not... ask him for some tips? Heh...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Y-You... how do you know that...? Could you be...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Captain, don't listen to it!

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Heh... go on, run while you still can... little chicks...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: But in the end, you'll understand... running won't save you... Only death... awaits you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's gone...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Our mission isn't over. We might have to face it again.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Next time we run into that bastard, I swear I'll...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Anleifr! Our priority is to complete our mission!

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: I know! But...!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Thinking like that is exactly what it wants. Calm down.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We should be the ones taking the initiative.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}'s right. We can't let our enemy drag us around. We push forward on our terms, and our plan.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Let us press on!

dialogues.speaker: Crowd
dialogues.text: Yes, sir!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Out of the way, move it!

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Hehe... What's the hurry...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: One way or another... you're all going to die. But some of you... just get to go a bit earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: He whined about not dying back then... Three years ago... And now... I'll fulfill his wish...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Bjorn? What did you do to him!?

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: He was too weak... the weaklings... Useless... Crawling insects...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: ...Dying is all they're good for, no?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Don't you dare insult him! He's not weak at all!

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Oh... In your eyes... he was strong...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: But... but the strong die all the same...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: I thought... you understood that better than anyone...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: The ones stronger than you... They all died, didn't they? They died three years ago... and ten years ago as well...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Shut your mouth!

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Yes... the only weak one here... is you...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Otherwise... why is it that every time... every time... you're the only one who survives?

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: ...You ran from the battlefield, didn't you? Just a coward clinging to life...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Illuga, don't listen to its nonsense!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Enough! Time to die!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #...{NICKNAME}! Let's finish this quickly!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Hmm... the old man's all set too. Excellent.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Yeah. Word from Piramida. The old man's been making his own preparations to fight that undying fiend. Things are going smoothly on his end... Now it's up to us.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's wrong? Something on your mind?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: ...Ah, it's nothing. Just thinking that I've still got a long way to go...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: I was worried because I didn't understand what the old man was trying to do... Must've made a fool of myself in front of you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've already done so well.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Thank you. I'll work harder from now on. I won't let anyone down.

choices.text: Get some rest. We'll need our strength for tomorrow.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: You too.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: That Evil Eye... it attacked before the barrier could be fully deployed! The altar ruins have been wrecked...

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Captain, can we redeploy it before it strikes again?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I'm afraid not. We failed to block that last attack, and the Silver Lampwick's energy has mostly drained away. There isn't enough left to deploy the barrier again.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: ...The situation is not looking good. We have no idea when that Evil Eye will launch its next attack. Without the barrier, it will be hard for us to hold this position.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: The monsters around us are increasing in number. Even if we hold them off for a while, our stamina isn't limitless. If things ever reach a point that...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Come on, brother, you're talking like you've already given up! Monsters? I don't care how many line up, I'll knock 'em all down!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Even so, trying to hold out here forever isn't a real plan...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is there really nothing we can do...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: ...I have an idea.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: You've got something? Quick, let's hear it!

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: The sealing array on Kipumaki Cliff was left to us by the Torchforger and the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions. Its structure must share the same origin as the Silver Lampwick.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: While deploying the barrier earlier, I noticed three Verdant Crests on the cliff flashing in response, almost as if they were resonating with it. Those should be the focal points of the sealing array.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, now that you mention it, Paimon can see them too.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: When I visited Hiisi Island, I borrowed some ancient Frostmoon Scions texts from the current Moonchanter. I remember seeing similar structures in those records, so I cross-checked my findings with her. I'm confident this is correct.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: However, the texts say that the sealing array should have four foci. For some reason, the most important one isn't resonating.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Still, the seal here has held for five hundred years. There must be something special about it. If we take the Silver Lampwick and activate the other three points first, we might be able to turn this around.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Captain, what do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...It's worth a try.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Great work, Bjorn!

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Hmph. Just so you know, I didn't spend the past three years doing nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But if we want to carry out this plan, we’ll need more support.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Bjorn, Anleifr, Rollon, return to Cliffwatch Camp at once. Report everything to the entire force, then lead the reinforcements and coordinate with us to take those three positions!

dialogues.speaker: All Three Together
dialogues.text: Yes, Captain!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: If the Evil Eye is targeting the Silver Lampwick, there's a good chance its next attack will go straight for it... I'll carry the Lampwick and activate the three focal points one by one.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, come with me. Protect the Silver Lampwick!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Any objections? It's extremely dangerous. If either of you doesn't want to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No need to ask. Of course I'm in, Captain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the perfect mission for us! We'll keep both Illuga and the Silver Lampwick safe!

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Music to my ears, hah! The captain's in your hands, then!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You all be careful too!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Understood.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Of course. I'm still waiting to see Anleifr land a punch on that fiend and shut it up for good.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: That right? Hah, I'd best not disappoint you then, eh? I won't just shut it up — hell, it'll be groveling at our feet like a mangy dog, begging for mercy!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Alright, enough joking around. We'll have plenty of time for that later. For now, let's move out!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: #Captain, {NICKNAME}, what brings you two here? No need to worry. Once we finish up, we'll head back to Piramida.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: This day has finally come...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You still up?

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Can't sleep with a battle like this on the horizon! You should, though. You're still growing, don't stunt that by staying up.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Verdant Crest resonates with the Silver Lampwick, unleashing a powerful surge of kuuvahki...

talks.objective: Clear the obstacles and continue onward
Check the status of the position

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...How is Bjorn?

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: ...He's badly injured. The attack came too suddenly, and to protect us, he... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: ...The battlefield was too dangerous, and he was in no state to be moved. We had no choice but to treat him here on the spot, but with the resources we have to hand, it's just...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: ...Captain...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Bjorn!

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry... I couldn't complete the mission...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: You did great! The position remains secure, and everyone's still safe...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Really...? I did it, then... That's good...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Stop talking. You need rest.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: If I don't say it now... I won't get another chance...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Don't say that! That's an order from your captain! You'll be fine... You'll be fine...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Heh... alright... as you command... I won't mention that again...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: But at least... I'll finally be able to face Veyde with no regrets...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: He would say... that we Lightkeepers are like Winter Iceleas...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: In the face of the Wild Hunt... each of us is fragile... like a Winter Icelea's petals... How easily we shatter...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: But... so long as the leaves remain... so long as the roots stay firmly in the soil...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: When the next season comes... and the one after that... new flowers will bloom anew...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: We will not fail... Isn't that right... Captain...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Yes. We will not fail! I will see that monster buried at my hands once and for all!

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: ...You're the strongest among us... I believe in you... Captain...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Rest assured, Bjorn. I'll keep our promise. Rest now... Things will have turned around by the time you recover...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #...{NICKNAME}, Paimon, we need to go. The mission isn't over yet. We can't stay here any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Illuga...

choices.text: We have to keep moving, for Bjorn's sake.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: ...Yeah. Let's keep going.

choices.text: We will defeat the enemy and claim victory.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem pretty relaxed.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: I've spent the last three years preparing for tomorrow's battle. At this point, there's no tension, only anticipation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope everything goes well tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Even if there's trouble, we'll handle it. Don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! That nasty Evil Eye's toast!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... did anyone see something fall off it?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That was likely the Spiralblade, the sacred blade the Torchforger once used to seal demons away. I didn’t expect a monster to seize it and use it against us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's what happened... B—But we should be safe for the moment, right?

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: For the moment, yes. The Evil Eye has been destroyed, and the monsters on the ground have been almost completely cleared out.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: But we can't let our guard down. That creature has probably slipped back underground. It's wounded, but it might still have a trick up its sleeve.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: We just went through a fierce battle. Everyone's exhausted, body and mind...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Doesn't matter. A win is a win! We got our revenge on that damn monster, and that's the score that counts!

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Speaking of which... where's Bjorn? I don't see him anywhere. Did he get held up helping out somewhere else?

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Who's gonna watch me show off my moves if he's not here? Can't be starting on my own, now can I?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: He... Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Illuga...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...He was struck by the Evil Eye's attack while defending the position...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: His injuries were too severe. We tried everything... but we couldn't save him.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: ...No way. How... How could that be!?

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: He had brains and brawn in spades. I never once beat him in a spar...! How could he go down so easily...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: This makes no sense... no sense at all!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Anleifr, stop crying...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: I'm not crying! Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Anleifr, pull yourself together. We need to be strong, especially now.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: That creature is using these vile methods to shake us, trying to slip in again while we're vulnerable. We can't let it succeed.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: We can't let that bastard stain Bjorn's sacrifice or turn it against us!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Illuga, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I... I'm fine.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I'm sorry. This is all my fault.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That monster knew. It knew everything... Knew this would shake my resolve...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Bjorn died because of me...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: ...Captain! That's not what I meant, I just... sigh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This isn't your burden alone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. All of us... We've gotta carry this together!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: My heart aches as well. But our mission isn't over yet. The battles ahead will only get harder, and we may suffer still more losses...

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: But no matter what happens, we cannot stop moving forward, forward unto final victory.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Weren't you the one who taught us that?

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: I believe in your command, Captain. Bjorn would feel the same. We carried out our duties, and whatever awaits us, we shall have no regrets.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Same for me, sir!

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: If wiping that cursed monster from this world for good means dying in the process, I'd gladly do it!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Don't say something that ominous. We're about to face it for real in a life-or-death battle.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Hey, as long as you get what I mean, brother. I'm gonna rip that thing's filthy mouth right off and make it beg on its knees!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yeah, as long as we can erase that wretched monster from this world for good...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...We don't have the combat power to face the upcoming battles alone. I'll need you to get reinforcements from the other positions.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, I'm leaving the area Bjorn previously handled to you. I'll stay here and hold this spot until you return.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, leave it to us!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Thank you. Just hold on a little longer... Soon, we'll claim victory.

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: "Why is it that every time... every time... you're the only one who survives?"

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (What am I supposed to do... What should I do...)

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: "...You ran from the battlefield, didn't you? Just a coward clinging to life..."

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (This is my fight... My battlefield...)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (I'm not... I'm not some coward who flees from danger...)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (This is my duty... I can't run anymore...)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (The fog's getting thicker. I can hardly see the path in front of us...)

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: ...We meet again, little chick... Shame that it's only you...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: No matter... Once I'm done with you, I'll send the others after you... one by one... Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Bark all you want while you still can. I'll make sure your silence is eternal!

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Hehe... All by yourself... You think you can stop me?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Taking down a lowlife like you is more than easy enough for me!

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: ...Oh... I see... I see why you didn't bring the other little fledglings with you...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: ...Deep down, you think they're weak too, don't you...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: ...The kind who die the moment no one's there to protect them...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: ...Just like you, little hatchling... Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Shut your filthy mouth. Die!

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Hehe... A seal like this will not hold me...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Anleifr! Rollon!

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Captain... We're fine!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: ...Captain! Watch out for that monster!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Monster! You'll pay for this!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Damn it... they just don't stop...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Hehe... Too much for you to stomach already? This is only the appetizer...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Soon... very soon... The Professor will ascend his tower... and open the path to the Elysium beyond...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: It will be a feast unlike anything this world has ever seen... ahh... Truly something to savor...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: We have waited far, far too long for this day...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: At last... We are but one step away...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Ten years ago... We failed... Three years ago as well... But this time... Never again...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I won't let you get your way! We won't let you get your way!

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: "We"... Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Have you ever considered... as you fight all alone...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: That those weak, defenseless teammates of yours... might already be dying outside... one after another...?

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Just like... Yes... Just like Winter Iceleas... A gust of wind, a touch of rain... and they wither... hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Shut up! I believe in them. They... They'll be fine...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: And I'm not some damn flower! Even if I were one, I'd be a demon-eating flower, made to devour scum like you alive!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Anleifr!? How did you...

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Talk later. Focus on taking down the enemy first.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Captain, give us the order!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: You guys...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Understood. Assist me. Together, we repair the seal, reclaim the Spiralblade, and bring this monster down!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrighty! You can count on us!

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Weaklings... Trash... Insects... No matter how many of you come... it changes nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: That damn monster's hiding again!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: As long as we repair the seal, it won't matter where it hides!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Time to rest...)

talks.objective: Defeat the Scourge of Endless Decay
Defeat the Scourge of Endless Decay

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Curse you... Curse you all...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: To think I'd lose to such... insignificant...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: You're the only insignificant one here. Hiding behind your venomous words, too afraid to face us!

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Hehe... Whatever you say...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: The Professor... Professor Rotwang... My exalted master... He has already set out...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Soon... very soon... he will tear apart the veil of this false world...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: Weak little humans...

dialogues.speaker: Scourge of Endless Decay
dialogues.text: In the end... it makes no difference... What awaits you all... is equality in... death...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Still mouthing off...!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: It's on its last legs! The abyssal energy around the Spiralblade has faded!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #Enough talking! {NICKNAME}, let's send it to hell!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally... this thing's done for good, right?

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Seems so. Not even ashes were left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Now then, let's have a proper talk, Captain...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Anleifr lands a heavy punch on Illuga...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: ...That was for Bjorn.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Alright, Captain. All done. You can punish me now.

choices.text: Punish me instead. If he hadn't done that, I would've.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: No... I won't punish you. You were right.

response.speaker: Rollon
response.text: Since you understand, Captain, I suppose I need say nothing more.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: I'm sorry... I lost my composure. It's just that at that moment, the thought that you might leave me as suddenly as Bjorn did...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: I just... I couldn't bear it...

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Captain! With all due respect...

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: You're not as strong as you think you are, and we're not as weak as you believe.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: That's why we fight side by side, no? That's why our squad exists.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Didn't you say you'd trust us to watch your back?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even if we're not strong enough alone, we can cut a path through any danger as long as we do it together!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Looks like it takes courage to trust others, too.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: #{NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Yes... It seems like I really was weak after all...

response.speaker: Rollon
response.text: My brother once told me, "Anyone who can face their own weakness will become stronger someday."

response.speaker: Rollon
response.text: You saved his life three years ago, Captain. If these words of his can ease your burden today, I'm sure it would bring him comfort as well.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Yeah. Thank you... all of you. I'll pull myself together.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Heh. After drawing so much strength and courage from you all, it'd be harder for me to not raise my game...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: The fight isn't over. Will you follow me and finish this final mission?

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Of course! And we're sticking close. Can't have our captain wandering off and disappearing on us!

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: ...Looks like I'll never live that one down.

response.speaker: Rollon
response.text: If it sounds harsh, just take it as a punishment. Honestly, I'd say it's pretty light as those go.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Yeah... I deserve it, anyway.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: #...Back to business. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and I will head back to Piramida first to report to the old man.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Once you've passed the message to our comrades who are holding the formations on the surface, return to Piramida as soon as you can and join the next phase of the operation.

response.speaker: Rollon
response.text: Leave it to us.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: To hell with all that "Professor" and "Student" nonsense. It's time we show 'em what we Lightkeepers are made of!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh oh... things look reeeeal bad around the Pillar of Embla...

choices.text: Punching him might've been a step too far...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true... but Paimon can't say she doesn't understand how Anleifr feels. You crossed a line this time, Illuga!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That monster mentioned that "the 'Professor' has already set forth." I fear that deathless fiend has set his sights on the Pillar of Embla...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is... Is Miss Alia gonna be ok?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All we can do now is trust her.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yeah — and make the most of every second she's fighting to buy us.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Completing our mission is the best way we can repay her.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: That should be everything... What's up? Something you'd like to ask?

response.speaker: Rollon
response.text: For many of us, the wounds from three years ago still haven't healed.

response.speaker: Rollon
response.text: My brother and I... we were the lucky ones. My brother's Ivar, by the way. The captain saved him. We both survived, and we can still carry out our duties as Lightkeepers.

response.speaker: Rollon
response.text: I just hope everything goes smoothly tomorrow. That way, we can at least bring some peace to our fallen comrades.

choices.text: It's nothing. Sorry to bother you.

response.speaker: Rollon
response.text: You should get some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Oh! Captain, once everything's set on our end, we'll regroup with you in Piramida.
